messages:
Sam M: Quick sync 12h out from webinar. Need final abstract tweaks and confirm the backup presenter. Also finalize lead routing thresholds.

Anya P: I updated the abstract to focus on cost-vs-latency tradeoffs and practical knobs (batching, quant, cache). Link: https://docs.redwood/marketing/webinar-abstracts#cost-latency. Can someone sanity-check the opening paragraph?

Leo B: Looks good. Suggest we call out a concrete number : "expect 2-4x cost reduction with prefix caching on typical conversational loads". Makes it less theoretical.

Anya P: Nice, added that. Also condensed the CTA to mention the dedicated trial.

Marco T: Speaker update: Celia will moderate, I'll demo. Backup presenter is Priya if I'm pulled into infra ops. Priya confirmed earlier but can we lock that?

Celia Q: Confirmed as moderator. I'll handle audience q's and timeboxing. I can also kick to recorded clip if demo breaks. Who's got the recorded clip and the timestamp?

Sam M: Recorded clip is at https://video.redwood/canned-demos/trimmed.mp4 (start 00:02:10). I'm adding a "panic button" command to the runbook to swap the live stream to the clip.

Leo B: For the panic button, ops needs a simple one-liner. Can we use the stream manager API? Example I tested:
```bash
# swap live to recorded clip
http POST https://streammgr.internal/api/swap mode=recorded clip_url='https://video.redwood/canned-demos/trimmed.mp4' Authorization:"Bearer $STREAM_KEY"
```

Anya P: Perfect. I'll paste that in the run-of-show. Also adding the slide deck link for speakers: https://drive.redwood/slides/webinar-apr-2026. Please check slide 7 for the demo story.

Marco T: Demo plan in brief: 1) quick intro 2) live q&a with model tuning knobs exposed 3) ramped load test to show autoscaling 4) short teardown. Backup flow: if latency > 500ms for >30s, switch to recorded + callout.

Celia Q: Lead routing: if signup form hits 3+ signups in any rolling 10min window, post to #sales-hot-leads and trigger WebhookBot to create a ticket. Otherwise send batched CSV to SDR inbox every 30min. Agree?

Sam M: Agree. WebhookBot, can you confirm webhook endpoint?

WebhookBot: [automated] webhook configured -> https://hooks.example.com/inbound/rdw-webinar-2026. Status: active.

Leo B: Also want immediate Slack ping to @oncall-sales when we cross the threshold, not just channel post. That way someone explicitly ACKs.

Anya P: I'll add escalation mapping: @oncall-sales for 3-9 signups, @growth-lead for 10+. Put it in the routing table in the runbook.

Marco T: Rehearsal note: please run the long-tail prompt (attached in the doc) that tends to create token-heavy outputs. We want to ensure prefix caching is correctly engaged.

Celia Q: AV check window: presenters join 20min prior. I will run a mic/echo check and a slide sync test. Everyone confirm availability 09:40 PT?

Sam M: Confirmed. Also adding a post-webinar email cadence: immediate thank-you with link, 48h follow-up with trial offer + benchmark PDF. Drafts in https://docs.redwood/marketing/post-webinar-templates.

Leo B: Anything on hallucination handling? If the model outputs unsafe content, presenters should say "Were switching to a safe demo" and flip to clip. Also log the prompt + response to /secure/logs for triage.

Anya P: Added canned line: "Were going to move to a safe demo while we investigate that response." Keep it short.

Celia Q: Last bit 1m try run-of-show update: timecodes, who speaks when, who mutes/unmutes. I'll publish tonight and share a one-pager for speakers.

Sam M: Thanks all. Final checklist items: slides locked, clip ready, runbook with API snippets, webhook verified, routing table, rehearsal at 10:10 PT. Meeting in #marketing 09:50 PT for 10min preflight. :rocket:
